versions.changelog:
## 1.0.1
- Added `version.txt` and updated `SKILL.md` frontmatter.
- Created `SETUP.md` with requirements and interactive setup guide.
- Added a `scripts/setup.py` validation script.
- Improved documentation on storage conventions and deterministic path resolution.

Initial release of hsil-monitor — a zero-code, shell-only agent skill to monitor Hang Seng Indexes notices and news.

- Fetches and monitors HSI press releases, notices, insights, and reports for new items.
- Bilingual matching (EN + 中文) against user-selected index codes (default: HSI/HSCEI/HSTECH).
- Emits one concise digest per run, grouping matched news; unmatched items are summarized as counts.
- Maintains deduplication and backfill state locally, supporting first-run window and reruns.
- Pure shell (curl, jq, coreutils); checks tool availability on startup.
- No delivery logic included — OpenClaw is responsible for routing.
